optimizedCVData.summary: Secondary education professional with 8 years of experience designing and delivering structured learning programs for diverse audiences, including students, parents, and teaching staff. Skilled in curriculum development, workshop facilitation, and translating complex technical content into clear, accessible formats for varied audiences and seniority levels. Proven ability to track cohort progress using spreadsheets and present data-driven results to senior leadership, with a growing foundation in Python and data analytics. Seeking to apply program design, stakeholder communication, and enablement skills in a customer education and scale onboarding context.

experience.position: Teacher of Physics and Head of Year 9
bullets: Design and deliver structured learning programs for 140 students a year across Years 9 to 13, adapting content and communication style to different ability levels and learning needs.
Authored the department's Year 9 practical curriculum from scratch and trained 12 colleagues to deliver it consistently, combining content development with peer enablement.
Track student progress in spreadsheets and present cohort-level results to senior leadership each term, translating raw data into clear performance narratives.

Manage ongoing communication with a year group of 210 students' families through weekly parent calls and two parents' evenings per term, engaging stakeholders across a wide range of backgrounds and expectations.
Taught KS3 and KS4 science across mixed-ability classes, planning and sequencing content to build understanding progressively.
Facilitated the school robotics club, introducing students to hands-on technical problem-solving in an informal, self-directed learning environment.
Adapted lesson delivery and resources to meet the needs of individual learners, developing early skills in one-to-one coaching and differentiated instruction.
Mentor children aged 9 to 12 in Scratch and introductory Python during evening sessions, breaking down programming concepts into age-appropriate, engaging activities.
Plan session content independently, sequencing topics to build confidence and practical skill over time.
Provide real-time feedback and encouragement in a small-group setting, adapting explanations on the fly to suit different learning paces.

analysis.summary: Daniel is a career-changer moving from secondary education into a customer-facing program management role, so the strategy was to reframe his teaching experience as scalable program delivery, curriculum design, and stakeholder communication. Verified skills around curriculum development, workshop facilitation, progress tracking, and multi-stakeholder communication were repositioned to align with Figma's Scale Onboarding requirements, while fabricated B2B SaaS or onboarding management claims were strictly excluded.
key_changes: Reframed the headline from 'Physics teacher' to a Program Manager / Customer Education positioning that mirrors the target role's language without fabricating B2B SaaS experience.
Repositioned curriculum design and workshop facilitation as enablement resource creation and program development, using only verified skills from the source CV.
Elevated the parent communication and senior leadership reporting bullets to highlight multi-persona stakeholder communication across different seniority levels, a direct JD requirement.

Surfaced the Year 9 curriculum authorship and 12-colleague training initiative as evidence of content development and scaled program rollout, the closest verified analogue to onboarding program management.
Kept all metrics strictly within the verified list (8 years, 140 students, 71% to 86%, 12 colleagues, 210 students) and wrote all other bullets without fabricated numbers.
Excluded all VERIFIED MISSING skills (B2B SaaS, customer onboarding, Figma, UX/UI, webinar delivery, marketing collaboration) entirely from every section of the CV.

Hiring Manager
Figma

Dear Hiring Manager,

Raising student attainment from 71% to 86% over three years required the same core skills Figma's Scale Onboarding program needs: designing structured programs, communicating complex material to varied audiences, and tracking what works with data.

As Head of Year 9 at Ashgrove Academy, I manage a year group of 210 students while simultaneously teaching physics to around 140 students annually, which means running high-volume, multi-stakeholder communication as a daily discipline. I designed the department's Year 9 practical curriculum and trained 12 colleagues to deliver it, building the kind of enablement resources and scalable content this role requires. I present progress metrics to senior leadership each term, and I am comfortable working in Google Workspace, Notion, and spreadsheet-based reporting tools. Figma's emphasis on partnering with sales, marketing, and enablement teams to develop and evolve onboarding programs maps directly to how I coordinate across staff, parents, and school leadership to drive outcomes at scale.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my background in curriculum design, workshop facilitation, and metrics-driven program development translates to the Scale Onboarding team at Figma.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Program Manager, Daniel Okafor
applicationEmail.body:
Hi there,

Managing 140 students a year across multiple year groups while tracking progress data and presenting results to senior leadership has given me a strong grounding in the skills this role calls for: structured program delivery, clear communication across different audiences, and keeping a high volume of people moving toward a defined outcome. I also designed and rolled out a practical curriculum used by 12 colleagues, which required the kind of cross-functional coordination and content development central to scale onboarding work. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I would welcome a call any weekday morning to discuss how my background could translate into value for Figma's onboarding programs.

Best regards,
Daniel Okafor
